plan.rationale: Sierra Reads EP. 2 — 'Hinge Anaphora' (writer-agent Draft 8). Triple-denial-then-confession-then-button. The triple denial of increasingly absurd Hinge stalking moves builds the absurdity, the confession admits it all, and the 'Today. Yet.' double-button is the dryest possible landing. Universal premise — every woman has either done this or watched her best friend do it.

script_chunks.text: I HAVE NOT CHECKED HIS HINGE.
I HAVE NOT MADE A FAKE HINGE.
I HAVE NOT PAID FOR HINGE PLUS
I HAVE DONE ALL OF THAT.

plan.voiceover_text: I have not checked his Hinge. I have not made a fake Hinge. I have not paid for Hinge Plus to filter by his exact height. I have done all of that. But I have not thought about him. Today. Yet.
plan.caption: 6'1, brown hair, 'looking for something serious' — anyway
